name: SPY Opening Range Breakout Reversal Analysis
description: Research study analyzing how often SPY price breaks out of the opening range (09:30-09:45 ET) in one direction, then reverses to break out in the opposite direction during the same trading day. This identifies false breakout patterns and whipsaw behavior.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SPY OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT REVERSAL ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Research Question: How often does SPY break out of the opening range in one
# direction, then reverse and break out in the opposite direction same day?
# Opening Range: 09:30-09:45 ET (first 15 minutes)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
open_price = src.o

# === OPENING RANGE SESSION (09:30-09:45 ET) ===
opening_range = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='09:45', tz='America/New_York'))()
or_high_raw = opening_range.high
or_low_raw = opening_range.low
or_open = opening_range.open
or_closed = opening_range.closed

# Forward-fill OR values to carry through the day
or_high = ffill()(or_high_raw)
or_low = ffill()(or_low_raw)

# Opening range size as percentage
or_range_pct = ((or_high - or_low) / or_low) if or_closed else 0

# === POST-OPENING RANGE SESSION (09:45-16:00 ET) ===
post_or = session_window(session=Session(start='09:45', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))()
post_or_high = post_or.high
post_or_low = post_or.low
post_or_closed = post_or.closed

# === BREAKOUT DETECTION ===
# Bullish breakout: post-OR high exceeds OR high
bullish_breakout = (post_or_high > or_high) if post_or_closed else False

# Bearish breakout: post-OR low falls below OR low
bearish_breakout = (post_or_low < or_low) if post_or_closed else False

# Both breakouts (reversal pattern)
both_breakouts = bullish_breakout and bearish_breakout

# Any breakout
any_breakout = bullish_breakout or bearish_breakout

# Breakout type classification
# 0 = no breakout, 1 = bullish only, 2 = bearish only, 3 = both (reversal)
breakout_type = 0 if (not any_breakout) else (3 if both_breakouts else (1 if bullish_breakout else 2))

# === COUNTS FOR AGGREGATION ===
no_breakout_count = 1 if (breakout_type == 0 and post_or_closed) else 0
bullish_only_count = 1 if (breakout_type == 1) else 0
bearish_only_count = 1 if (breakout_type == 2) else 0
reversal_count = 1 if (breakout_type == 3) else 0
any_breakout_count = 1 if any_breakout else 0
day_count = 1 if post_or_closed else 0

# === TIME FEATURES ===
bar_idx = index()
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(bar_idx)

# === REVERSAL RATE CALCULATION ===
# Rolling 60-day window reversal rate
rolling_reversals = sum(period=60)(reversal_count)
rolling_any_bo = sum(period=60)(any_breakout_count)
rolling_reversal_rate = rolling_reversals / rolling_any_bo if rolling_any_bo > 0 else 0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 0: KEY METRICS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Opening Range Breakout Statistics',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Reversal Rate', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Reversals / Any Breakout', card_color=Color.Warning),
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Days', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_color=Color.Primary),
            ColumnSpec(title='Any Breakout', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_color=Color.Info),
            ColumnSpec(title='Reversals (Both)', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_color=Color.Error),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bullish Only', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bearish Only', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_color=Color.Error),
            ColumnSpec(title='No Breakout', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_color=Color.Muted),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg OR Size', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, info='Average opening range width')
        ]
    ),
    category='0. Summary'
)(reversal_count / any_breakout_count if any_breakout_count > 0 else 0, day_count, any_breakout_count, reversal_count, bullish_only_count, bearish_only_count, no_breakout_count, or_range_pct)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 1: BREAKOUT PATTERNS
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    title='Breakout Patterns by Type',
    category='1. Breakout Patterns',
    x_axis_label='Pattern Type',
    y_axis_label='Number of Days',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='No Breakout', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Bullish Only', color=Color.Green),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Bearish Only', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Both (Reversal)', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(no_breakout_count, bullish_only_count, bearish_only_count, reversal_count)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Reversal Rate',
    category='1. Breakout Patterns',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='Reversal Rate',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Reversal Rate', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ])
)(bar_idx, rolling_reversal_rate)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 2: DAY OF WEEK ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    title='Reversal Count by Day of Week',
    category='2. Day of Week Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Day',
    y_axis_label='Number of Reversals',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek
)(values=reversal_count, label=day_of_week)

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    title='Breakout Days by Day of Week',
    category='2. Day of Week Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Day',
    y_axis_label='Days with Any Breakout',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek
)(values=any_breakout_count, label=day_of_week)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 3: OPENING RANGE CHARACTERISTICS
# =============================================================================

histogram(
    title='Opening Range Size Distribution',
    category='3. Opening Range Analysis',
    x_axis_label='OR Size (%)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Blue
)(value=or_range_pct)

xy_scatter(
    title='Opening Range Size vs Reversal',
    category='3. Opening Range Analysis',
    x_axis_label='OR Size (%)',
    y_axis_label='Reversal (1=Yes, 0=No)',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Reversal Pattern', color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ])
)(or_range_pct, reversal_count)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 4: DETAILED DATA
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Daily Breakout Analysis',
        include_timestamp=True,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Range %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Post-OR High', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Post-OR Low', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bullish BO', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bearish BO', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Reversal', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Valid Day', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Detailed Data'
)(or_high, or_low, or_range_pct, post_or_high, post_or_low, bullish_breakout, bearish_breakout, both_breakouts, post_or_closed)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 5: SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakout Statistics Summary',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Total Days', 'Days with Breakout', 'Reversals', 'Bullish Only', 'Bearish Only'],
        col_headers=['Count', 'Percentage'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Warning),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Warning),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Error),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Error)
        ]
    ),
    category='5. Summary Table'
)(day_count, day_count / day_count if day_count > 0 else 0, any_breakout_count, any_breakout_count / day_count if day_count > 0 else 0, reversal_count, reversal_count / any_breakout_count if any_breakout_count > 0 else 0, bullish_only_count, bullish_only_count / any_breakout_count if any_breakout_count > 0 else 0, bearish_only_count, bearish_only_count / any_breakout_count if any_breakout_count > 0 else 0)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Reversal Days',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Day High', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Day Low', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='OR Range %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(both_breakouts, or_high, or_low, post_or_high, post_or_low, or_range_pct)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Bullish Breakouts Only',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Day High', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Breakout Size %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(breakout_type == 1, or_high, post_or_high, (post_or_high - or_high) / or_high)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Bearish Breakouts Only',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Day Low', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Breakout Size %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(breakout_type == 2, or_low, post_or_low, (or_low - post_or_low) / or_low)
